mono.usage: Ticker symbols, numerical data, real-time prices

layout.spacing_system: Generous spacing inside components but tight grids. p-4 to p-6 for card internals.
layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (MODE B) - Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized, no jagged bottoms.
layout.alignment: Left-align dense content and metrics. Optical alignment for icons.

surface_strategy.cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px subtle border (border-[#E5E0D8]), rounded-md. No heavy drop shadows. Hover states: -translate-y-[2px], subtle shadow-lg.
surface_strategy.header: Solid background with hard bottom border to separate from scrollable areas. Z-index 50.

components.charts: Recharts for standard lines/bars. Use area charts for prices. For candlesticks, compose using custom SVG/Recharts or a dedicated lightweight library.
components.customizations: Remove default vercel-look. Apply sharp borders, organic color palette, and 'IBM Plex Sans' text to UI primitives. Ensure high contrast.

motion.hover: Subtle color darkening and slight lift (-translate-y-[2px]) for actionable cards. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for bento grid widgets.
motion.real_time_updates: Subtle background flash (green/red) on price tick updates for 500ms before returning to normal.

icons.style: Duotone or bold weight for primary metrics, regular for lists.

image_urls.description: User profile picture for the header nav.

features: Buscador de acciones (Stock search bar for tickers like AAPL, TSLA)
Ticker de precios en vivo (Live price ticker)
Gráfico interactivo de velas (Interactive candlestick chart with RSI, MACD, Bollinger, Fibonacci, MA)
Panel de recomendación IA (AI buy/sell recommendation with confidence score)
Niveles de soporte y resistencia (Key buy/sell levels visualization)
Zonas sugeridas de Stop-loss y Take-profit
Fundamentales de la empresa (Market cap, P/E, dividend, etc.)
Selector de modelo LLM (GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 3 Flash)
Feed de noticias de la acción

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Green/Red cues must have secondary visual indicators (like arrows or icons) for colorblindness.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='buy-recommendation-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layout (Control Room Grid). Do not use Shadcn 'Card' for structural layout containers, use them for actual widgets.
Build the dashboard emphasizing the 'Top-left north star metric' pattern. The AI Buy/Sell recommendation and confidence score should be highly visible.
The app MUST be in SPANISH.
Ensure 'IBM Plex Mono' or a monospace font is used for all numerical data and tickers.
Design an explicit toggle/dropdown for the LLM Model Selector (GPT-5.2, Claude, Gemini) in the header or AI panel.
DO NOT use Inter font. Follow the Organic & Earthy color palette strictly (no teal, no purple). Use Moss Green and Terracotta for financial indicators.
